race.comment: FIERCE CRITIC (4) has stronger back-form than most of these and resumes with two trials behind her; the plain Warwick Farm finish before the spell is a query, but her Hawkesbury placing before that keeps her right in the race. Can resume with a bang. NICOLOSI (7) has had three trials in readiness so she can run a forward race on resumption. BAYLIE'S FOLLY (8) resumes after tackling a CG Open last campaign. Expect he will be primed for this. MACCBI (1) is still a maiden after 10 starts but was placed at Hawkesbury when resuming before finishing fifth at Kembla Grange last start. Definite chance for the minors.
